package player

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	"example.com/dungeon-rank-review/game/dungeon"
	playerentity "example.com/dungeon-rank-review/game/entities/player"
	worldentity "example.com/dungeon-rank-review/game/entities/world"
	gamehandler "example.com/dungeon-rank-review/game/handler"
	playeraccess "example.com/dungeon-rank-review/game/playeraccess"
	"example.com/dungeon-rank-review/game/ranking"
	"example.com/dungeon-rank-review/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/spf13/viper"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/app"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/clock"
	svcrank "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/rank"
	svcsession "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/session"
)

type reviewDungeonGetter map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity

func (g reviewDungeonGetter) Get(_ context.Context, id int64, _ entity.EntityCategory) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	value, ok := g[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown review entity %d", id)
	}
	return value, nil
}

func (g reviewDungeonGetter) GetMany(ctx context.Context, ids []int64, categories []entity.EntityCategory) ([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	values := make([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		value, err := g.Get(ctx, id, categories[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		values[i] = value
	}
	return values, nil
}

// 本探针只验证行为，不声称真实 WAL fsync、Redis Lua 或服务间网络验收。
type reviewDungeonCommitter struct{}

func (*reviewDungeonCommitter) Commit(context.Context, dataengine.CommitRecord) error { return nil }

// session.Finish 的重放契约：相同 run 始终返回原成功终态；奖励仍走正式 Nest handler。
type reviewDungeonSessions struct {
	svcsession.Session
	resolvedAt int64
}

func (s reviewDungeonSessions) Finish(_ context.Context, owner int64, runID string, _ svcsession.State, _ string) (svcsession.Run, error) {
	return svcsession.Run{ID: runID, OwnerID: owner, Kind: "dungeon", State: svcsession.StateSucceeded, FinishedAtUnix: s.resolvedAt}, nil
}

func TestDungeonRankingReplayAfterNineClears(t *testing.T) {
	playerentity.RegisterEntity()
	worldentity.RegisterEntity()
	gamehandler.RegisterClaimDungeonNestHandlers()
	const playerID int64 = 4242
	playerFullID, err := entity.BuildEntityID(playerID, playerentity.EntityKindPlayer)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	worldID, err := entity.BuildEntityID(1, worldentity.EntityKindWorld)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	builtPlayer, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Kind: playerentity.EntityKindPlayer, Id: playerFullID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	builtWorld, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Kind: worldentity.EntityKindWorld, Id: worldID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	subject := builtPlayer.(*playerentity.Player)
	world := builtWorld.(*worldentity.World)
	engine := nest.NewEngine(
		nest.NestOptionWithGetter(reviewDungeonGetter{playerFullID: subject, worldID: world}),
		nest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(&reviewDungeonCommitter{}),
		nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 1, QueueCap: 16}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}),
	)
	if err := engine.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = engine.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
	board, err := svcrank.NewRedisStore(newReviewRankRedis(), svcrank.RedisConfig{Prefix: "review:dungeon-rank"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	controller := &Controller{
		registry: app.NewRegistry(viper.New()), nestClient: engine, worldID: worldID,
		sessions: reviewDungeonSessions{resolvedAt: clock.Now().Unix()}, ranking: board,
	}
	ctx := &playeraccess.Context{BaseCtx: context.Background(), PlayerID: playerID}
	for i := 0; i < 9; i++ {
		response, err := controller.HandleFinishDungeon(ctx, &pb.FinishDungeonRequest{RunID: fmt.Sprintf("review-run-%d", i), Success: true})
		if err != nil || response == nil || response.Code != 0 || response.ExpGranted != dungeon.ClearExp {
			t.Fatalf("clear %d: response=%+v err=%v", i, response, err)
		}
	}
	entry, found, err := board.Rank(context.Background(), ranking.ClearsBoard(), playerID)
	if err != nil || !found || entry.Score.Value != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("initial rank=%+v found=%v err=%v", entry, found, err)
	}
	replay, err := controller.HandleFinishDungeon(ctx, &pb.FinishDungeonRequest{RunID: "review-run-0", Success: true})
	if err != nil || replay == nil || replay.Code != 0 || replay.ExpGranted != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("replay reward=%+v err=%v", replay, err)
	}
	if world.Dao().GetExpGranted() != 9*dungeon.ClearExp || subject.Dao().DungeonClaimsLen() != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("reward ledger or exp changed on replay: claims=%d exp=%d", subject.Dao().DungeonClaimsLen(), world.Dao().GetExpGranted())
	}
	entry, found, err = board.Rank(context.Background(), ranking.ClearsBoard(), playerID)
	if err != nil || !found {
		t.Fatalf("rank after replay: found=%v err=%v", found, err)
	}
	if entry.Score.Value != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("nine clears then replaying the first gives %d leaderboard points; want 9 (reward claims remain 9)", entry.Score.Value)
	}
}
